sentences.ko: 파티엔 갈게. 근데 차려입고 가진 않을 거야.
sentences.text: I'll come to the party, but I'm not dressing up.

alts.text: Fine, I'm in — just no costume, though.
Yes, I will attend the party, but I will not be wearing a costume.

sentences.note: **dressing up**은 파티에 맞춰 옷을 차려입거나 분장하는 것을 말해요. 가긴 가는데 조건을 하나 걸고 싶을 때 쓰는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 나 뭐 빠지려고 이러는 거 아니야.
sentences.text: I'm not trying to get out of anything.

alts.text: Not dodging anything, swear.
Please understand that I am not attempting to avoid any of my responsibilities.

sentences.note: **get out of**는 하기 싫은 일이나 약속에서 슬쩍 빠져나가는 거예요. 핑계 대는 걸로 오해받았을 때 이렇게 말해요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 나 너한테 또 반하는 것 같아.
sentences.text: I think I'm falling in love with you all over again.

alts.text: Ugh, I'm totally falling for you all over again.
It seems that I am falling in love with you once again.

sentences.note: **all over again**은 '처음부터 또 한 번'이라는 뜻이에요. 오래 만난 사람에게 다시 설렐 때 씁니다. 캐주얼한 **falling for**도 '반하다'라는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.text: So, why don't you just pick one and that'll be it.

alts.text: Just pick one and you're done.
Perhaps you could simply choose one, and that would settle the matter.

sentences.note: **why don't you**는 '~하지 그래?' 하고 가볍게 권하는 말이에요. **that'll be it**은 '그걸로 끝'이라는 뜻이라, 오래 고민하는 사람에게 결정을 재촉할 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 전화 요금 고지서가 왔는데 바로 안 내는 거지.
sentences.text: The phone bill arrives, but you don't pay it right away.

alts.text: Bill shows up, and you just sit on it for a while.
When the telephone bill arrives, you do not pay it immediately.

sentences.note: **right away**는 '곧바로'라는 뜻으로 일상에서 아주 자주 써요. 캐주얼한 **sit on it**은 할 일을 손대지 않고 미뤄 두는 거예요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 둘 다 제발 어른답게 좀 굴래?
sentences.text: Would you both please start acting like adults?

alts.text: Can you two just grow up already?
I would like both of you to behave like adults, please.

sentences.note: **acting like adults** 는 유치하게 다투는 사람들한테 '어른스럽게 좀 해' 라고 할 때 씁니다. 더 짧게는 **grow up** 이라고 하면 됩니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 내일 뉴욕 가야 돼. 그건 진짜 싫은데, 그래도 아들 얼굴은 볼 수 있으니까 좋아.
sentences.text: I'm leaving for New York tomorrow, which I hate, but I get to see my son, who I love.

alts.text: Heading to New York tomorrow. Ugh. But hey, I'll see my son.
Tomorrow I am travelling to New York, which I do not enjoy, although I will be able to see my son, whom I love very much.

sentences.note: **I get to** 는 '~할 수 있게 되다' 인데, 좋은 기회가 생겼다는 기분이 담겨 있습니다. **which I hate** 처럼 말 중간에 내 기분을 덧붙이는 것도 대화에서 흔히 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 가기 싫은 이유 딱 하나만 제대로 대 봐.
sentences.text: Give me one good reason why you don't want to go.

alts.text: Okay, why not? One good reason.
Could you tell me one good reason that you do not wish to attend?

sentences.note: **Give me one good reason** 는 상대가 버틸 때 '납득할 만한 이유를 대 봐' 하고 몰아붙이는 말입니다. 친구가 약속에 빠지려 할 때 딱 맞습니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.text: I'll bet it went better than you think.

alts.text: Bet you did fine, honestly.
I am sure that it went better than you believe.

sentences.note: **I'll bet** 는 '분명 ~일 거야' 하고 확신을 담아 말할 때 씁니다. 면접이나 발표를 망쳤다고 걱정하는 친구를 달랠 때 쓰기 좋습니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 우리 생각엔 걔가 좀 억지 부리는 것 같아서 그래.
sentences.text: We just think that maybe she's being a little unreasonable.

alts.text: She's kinda being unfair, don't you think?
In our opinion, she may be acting somewhat unreasonably.

sentences.note: **being unreasonable** 은 '말이 안 통하게 억지 부린다' 는 뜻으로, be 동사를 진행형으로 쓰면 '지금 이 일에서만' 그렇다는 느낌이 납니다. **We just think that maybe** 처럼 말을 부드럽게 깔아 두면 덜 공격적으로 들립니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends
